svg.text: How Does the Node.js Event Loop Work?
Synchronous code → microtasks → async sources → Event Loop phases → again and again
Important: the executor of new Promise() runs synchronously.
Runs immediately after sync code, before other microtasks.

text.tspan: An async function starts synchronously; the continuation

svg.text: These callbacks enter different Event Loop phases.
After phase 5, the Event Loop starts again from 1

text.tspan: do not always have a fixed order.
microtask — only its executor runs sync.
Then the Event Loop handles timers / poll / check
